notes.title: Update - new decoration models
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Patrons![/h1]

We've been a little bit silent for a while, but it's time to bring back some love to Patron!
Judging by activity from players, especially ones that play longer hours, we've noticed that you like to "reward" your medieval city with good looks. And that is perfectly ok - if you succeeded in making your settlement into prosperous, well organized city, it's only fair that it looks like one too!

In any case, in this update we're adding a few more options to decoration system:

* 3 entirely new decoration models
* 2 of these models are modular - you can connect them and combine in multitude of ways
* 1 is a standalone - simple, easy to place and with a dash of style

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/ea62b6d543a860b46ee2f341556f1fdebaa906ba.jpg[/img]

Hopefully, these additions will expand your creativity and increase flexibility in creating portions of your city into something you're really proud of!
Feel free to share your interesting creations to everyone is screenshots gallery. Make everyone envy you!

As always, have fun and let us know what you think!

[b]Overseer Games[/b]

notes.title: New Kaiserpunk Playtest is around the corner
notes.content:
[h2]Hello,[/h2]

This week, from [b]Friday Nov 29th until Dec 3rd[/b], a public Playtest, second one, will be held for Kaiserpunk. This game features a full production chain city builder mechanics combined with many grand strategy elements, all set in an alternative history of the first half of the 20th century.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/4a0d1b4a42c694dd85efbc99a73037f15bbb2c0c.jpg[/img]

Rebuild your own city and territory, set up production and logistics, then take your success to the global stage and spread order to over 100 world regions. Tools of getting there can be pure military conquest, diplomacy or economic domination, whichever suits you best.

This is the second Playtest for Kaiserpunk and playable version will be [b]much more completed than the demo several months back[/b]. There is still much work to be done but this version should clearly showcase what the game is all about.

You can apply for the Playtest through simple [i]Request Access[/i] button [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012190/KAISERPUNK/]on the Kaiserpunk store page[/url] and access will be granted when Playtest officially starts on [b]November 29th[/b].

Take a look, give it a spin and give us any feedback you'd like to share with devs. You can do so on Steam, Discord ( https://discord.gg/6FfVfPfDNz ) or email kaiserpunk_support@overseer-publishing.com .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/eafff751bbae5a1085cab07f7378352179bd397d.jpg[/img]

Any and all constructive feedback to help complete this complex game is truly appreciated. Besides adding a lot of recently completed features, feedback from first Playtest also impacted many changes and improvements to previous features. Feedback from this Playtest will help improve the game further.

Just a few significant additions you can expect in this round of Playtest:
[list]
[*][b]Flag design[/b] – You're leading a new nation, you should have a flag…your own designed flag
[*][b]Selection of heritages[/b] – German, Western allies, Russian… choose your starting heritage
[*][b]Social pillars[/b] – set your political alignment
[*][b]Tutorial 2.0[/b] - sections completely reworked based on player input from earlier Playtest
[*][b]Maps[/b] – over 20 maps available through 4 different geographical biomes
[*][b]More stories[/b] – multiple new stories with players choices and mutual causality
[*][b]Diplomacy system[/b] – If that's your strong side, war isn't the only option anymore
[*][b]Basic trade system[/b] – can't find and produce all the riches on your own? Trade for them!
[*][b]Tier 3 production chains and buildings[/b] – build more, build bigger
[*][b]Reworked world map HUD[/b] – previous feedback from players gave us many ideas for improvements, so voila
[*][b]UI/UX 2.0[/b] – what can we say? It's much better
[*][b]Army specializations[/b]
[*][b]Army units and buildings up to Tier 3[/b] (out of 4 in total)
[*][b]Decorations system[/b] (2 out of 3 tiers finished) – much bigger city you can now build needs to be shown off, right? 
[*][b]Combat improvements[/b] – more options and feedback before and during combat phases [/list]
We'd like to invite you all to participate in this play session. 

Game isn't yet completed, but it's getting there fast, and with your help it'll be even faster. Black Friday is coming up, so why not use this opportunity for some free gaming enjoyment?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/9fb5f65919529a50d4722849aa41871b634592ae.jpg[/img]

[h2]See you there![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012190/KAISERPUNK/

notes.title: Hot summer update – v1.906.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Patrons,[/h2]

This long summer is relentless (at least where we are), but here is something to make your gaming days a bit more interesting!

In this summer update for Patron, we've finally „broke the code“ and introduced research stacking, a feature frequently requested by you. For some reason, it kept giving us troubles but it's sorted now and you can finally set multiple reseraches to be researched in given order. If you already know the technology path you wish to take, this should make your life easier.

Another frequently asked detail is addition of open mini map right at the start of the game when you're selecting a spot for your Town center. Now you can have a neat overview of surrounding area to choose from where you want to start building your city, relative to resources, shores and any other geographical feature you deem important.

Content wise, there is an expansion of various sculptures and statues in decoration section. This should be useful once you reach a level of wealth that simply needs to be shown to everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/cd642fb3d96c91453c8eb739f1d1a363dd066145.png[/img]

Part of this update is also few more optimization thingies, mainly model optimizations and shader tweaks.

A batch of bug fixes and language patches of various scope is ofcourse mandatory with every update, so we didn't skip it this time either.

Hope your Patron experience will get another enhancement with this update!

[u][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]ADDED: Additional 5 decoration busts
[*]ADDED: Additional 5 decoration statues
[*]ADDED: Research stacking – you can now initiate a stack of technologies to be researched in sequential order
[*]ADDED: Mini map will now be shown when you're placing a Town center at the game start
[*]UPDATED: Additional optimization of several shaders
[*]UPDATED: Additional optimization of several 3D models
[*]FIXED: Text correction on First King mission
[*]FIXED: Fixed italian language
[*]FIXED: Numerous smaller bugs 
[/list]

[h2]Have a pleasant July, and until next time!
Overseer Games[/h2]

notes.title: Pre-summer upgrade – update 1.904.0
notes.content:
[i][b]Greetings Patrons![/b][/i]

In line with announcement from a few days ago, we're releasing next Patron update today! Work was done in several areas from continuous [b]optimizations, bugfixes[/b] and additions of a few [b]quality of life[/b] and useability perspectives.

To dive deeper and find more room for performance gains, we've performed a very lenghty testing sessions to monitor the hardware stress and deduce when and why stress is increased. In this instance, particular emphasis was put to find a way to bring optimizations that could impact lower-end GPU's. 

Acording to results we've been getting, performance (especially in lower end hardware) should be more consistent now, shouldn't have significant drops with hundreds of citizens and hundreds of buildings, and occassional issue where frame dropped during ingame winter time should be resolved now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/de4bf7373c000cb7dcdc8a0611f92158c214692c.jpg[/img]

At the same time, while diving deep, we've also identified some areas that could increase performace even more, but more extensive changes will need to be made. That's something we'll include in more future updates.

We've also fixed several bugs you've reported with stock panel, numerous notification errors and visual glitches.

Lastly, selection for several frequent keyboard layouts has been completed too.

[i][u]List of notable update elements: [/u][/i]
[b][u]CHANGES[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED: Stock panel – when resources are sorted by quantity, selected resource won't randomly change when numerical value changes
[*]FIXED: Shadows for numerous objects are now rendered properly at intended level of distance. They will not disappear prematurely

[*]OPTIMIZED: Very extensive optimization of all free Halloween DLC 3D models

[*]OPTIMIZED: Several tree models in Patron base game
[*]OPTIMIZED: Transport wagons 3D models for all farms highly optimized
[*]OPTIMIZED: Text renderings in many panels improved and made less hardware demanding
[*]OPTIMIZED: During winter times, frame drop should be eliminated
 [/list]

May your experience be smoother then ever. We have more in store for future updates, so keep us informed of your experiences!

[i][b]Enjoy and govern on!
Overseer Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Getting both the lack and excess of population under control – Update 1.902.0
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Patrons![/h1]

According to numerous reactions from many of you, and what troubles can arise in longer gameplay sessions, we’ve decided to pack together numerous modifications to game features impacting two of the most prominent problems some players are encountering – the [u][b]lack or slow growth of the population[/b][/u], or the opposite situation with these numbers [u][b]snowballing after a while[/b][/u].

General idea was to boost the possible population growth in earlier stages of the game, and slow it down after certain number of ingame years. At the same time, tweaks have been also made to system managing the speed with which resources are distributed around your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/41c34af906bf3e34afb54d6af20f87632c59afa8.jpg[/img]

Changing any of these numbers in a full game featuring so many interlinked numbers and calculations was rather tricky, but from all the testing we've done, it should work properly and as intended. If you notice any weird consequences, please do let us know so we can adjust it more if needed.

Let’s go over the list of changes for this update:

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]
[list]
[*] MODIFIED: Movement speed of dedicated carriers (in jobs board) is increased by 10%
[*] MODIFIED: After 20 and 40 ingame years, carrier speed is increased by further 4%
[*] MODIFIED: When production building requires a critical resource, carrier will go pick it up even if drop off distance is further away
[*] MODIFIED: If some resource is very abundant in warehouse, carriers will pick up larger quantity for delivery then usual
[*] MODIFIED: Road signs increase road travel speed by additional 2% after 20 ingame years
[*] MODIFIED: After 20 ingame years, and once city gets much bigger, number of required dedicated carriers is slightly increased
[*] MODIFIED: in first several years of your colony, 2-4 additional colonists will arrive to your city per year
[*] MODIFIED: if your colony exceeds 1000 citizens, natural birthrate will slow down after ingame year 40, then 60, then 80 again, further reducing snowball effect
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/208c25b029b84455693429d5f5ba470eae03d869.jpg[/img]

With all these changes, it should be easier to start your colony and manage its growth in first critical years. After that, once you get to later stages of the game, sudden overpopulation and strain on already established production chains should be easier to control.

Hope it will further improve your experience and help you build sustaining and long lasting medieval colony!

Govern on!

notes.title: Story questline addition + another targeted optimization pack
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Patrons![/h1]

Fall is fast approaching, and to alleviate the boredom of long rainy days, we've been preparing to add another update to Patron. This time it's [b]mainly focused on new content elements[/b].

Let's get straight into the details of it: First of all, biggest addition in this update is opening up a long [b]questline[/b] that will start relatively early in the game and ask players to fulfill tasks asked by the King. Basically, the mainland Kingdom gets involved in a costly and long war alongside its borders. To successfully turn the tide of the conflict, they will need all the help they can get, and your thriving colony will get a chance to step up and offer assistance, in terms of steady stream of supplies or trained troops. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/b4623d38766db635fe366fc6172075f50bfc367a.jpg[/img]

Everything you've been building in your colony in the new land will now get a chance to become an important asset in helping your mainland bretheren fending off the hostile invasion. If your city/colony is strong enough to offer that assistance, you'll prove once and for all that you were the right choice to lead the settlement and King's faith in you was justified all along.

In economical terms, all you'll be required to keep sending assistance when asked for is to secure sufficient production and ensure specific surpluses for resources your mainland is missing at a specific points of the conflict. On the other side, if you're asked for fresh troops directly, you'll have to build a [b]barracks[/b] and train required amount of troops.

Besides story questline, another element of this update is another batch of [b]optimizations[/b], this time affecting your citizens, how their simulations are calculated and presented. In our internal tests new system yielded some noticeable gains in performance, depending on specific hardware and overall citizen numbers in your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/38bd73ed6710324ce821dc81937522f671ddcced.jpg[/img]

Lastly, today's update brings several [b]bugfixes[/b] that correct some annoying bugs our players have been reporting in recent weeks.

[b][u]CHANGES[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]ADDED: Campaign questline and linked worldmap
[*]ADDED: New available building - Barracks
[*]OPTIMIZATION: reworked system governing citizen background simulations
[*]FIXED: Possible CTD during reloading on specific maps eliminated 
[*]FIXED: Trade panel won't suddenly open and close when you click on Dock icon (if Dock icon is below Cancel icon on panel)
[*]FIXED: Numerous corrections to texts in different languages 
[/list]

Hope you'll enjoy the new content! Until the next update, you're welcome to leave your comments, reactions, any feedback or suggestions - on either Steam forums or our Discord channel. We're there regulary and ready to help out!

[i][b]Keep governing![/b][/i]

notes.title: Celebrating two year release anniversary with awesome update and hefty discount!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi honorable Patrons![/h1]

In a few days we'll celebrate the [b]two year anniversary[/b] of Patron release. A lot has been changed, expanded and improved during this time and we're happy majority of players appreciate this continuous effort to make the experience ever more enjoyable. Heck, a lot of ideas came directly from you so [b]big thanks for supplying us with such a nice amount of inspiration![/b]

So, for the occassion, we've naturally prepared some [u][b]nice surprises[/b][/u]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/2b17683a6d5f90deac2917f9a399d880c855c0bd.jpg[/img]

Central element of today's update is the addition of [b]„Creative“ game mode[/b]. This has been requested numerous times by so many of you, so it's here now. When you start the New game you'll be prompted to choose between two game modes – [b]Sandbox and Creative[/b]. First is basically the original game mode that existed from before: All game rules apply, players faces challenges with securing resources, balancing societal issues, tackling problems and disasters, forces the way ahead through resources and everything else connected to selected game difficulty.

[u]Creative mode[/u] is a special game mode that [b]OPENS EVERYTHING[/b] to players. Entire research tree is available from the start, [b]ALL RESOURCES ARE INFINITE[/b], Citizens will always spaws in sufficient numbers, access to all buildings is open and so on… you get the picture. This mode is for anyone wishing to simply spend some time playing the role of ultimate medieval urbanist. If you were a mayor of a medieval city, with limitless resources and logistics – [u][i][b]what kind of marvelous city would you create?[/b][/i][/u] Only sky is the limit…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/ebedf0924363999d3b147d16ca3779978a7af3f8.jpg[/img]

We hope you'll enjoy this new dimension of Patron, and that you'll go wild building impressive urban fantasies. We'll be happy to take a look at what you come up with. Feel free to [b]share it via Steam community screenshots of on our Discord[/b].

Another important thing in this update is the introduction of [b]„automatic jobs board“[/b]. This means you can now check this option on ingame jobs board and all jobs will be automatically populated depending on available citizen numbers, stage of building upgrades and current city requirements.

More detailed list of v1.610.0 content:
[b][u]CHANGES[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]ADDED: Second game mode: Creative mode with unlimited resources and people, as well as all researches and buildings unlocked
[*]ADDED: Jobs board now has „automatic“ option
[*]ADDED: Several new flags for players to choose from
[*]UPDATED: Another batch of 3D models optimized for faster performance
[*]UPDATED: Trees in orchards now use different drawing system aimed at increased game performance
[*]UPDATED: Visual improvements on water wells
[*]FIXED: Hitting ESC button in main menu doesn't initiate save loading anymore
[*]FIXED: Error disabling more then one on screen notification is removed. All notifications are now clearly visible
[*]FIXED: Numerous corrections to text in several languages
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/491fb7ac685b4f80b78ff1ee9a3d8e96641b210e.png[/img]

Hope you'll like the contents of this update! Thank you for following us in this two year journey, and see you on next update!

[b]Enjoy and have fun!
Overseer Games[/b]

notes.title: Extensive optimization package, part two - v1.501.0
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Patrons,[/h1]

As announced yesterday, our testing of second optimization package is now concluded and ready for all of you!

In general, this update includes further interventions to [b]improve game performance[/b]. Technical details are similar to last update, but this time optimizations include much more models, and they go deeper in multiple layers. Today's update also includes [b]improvements to foliage, trees, farm plants, as well as upgrades to level of details on various zoom levels[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/a9083944aa6dfc4385cbd8879af9ebac706bd37b.jpg[/img]

After both optimization packages are installed, there should be a significant [b]reduction of loading times[/b], [b]better performance[/b] when numerous buildings are constructed and more precise handling on citizens once they reach higher numbers. Note that bottlenecks we've been resolving with these two updates weren't equally visible on all machines. It mainly depends on specific hardware you use, so that means that gains will also vary. During our testing we've noticed bigger improvements on relatively slower machines. [b]Loads on your CPU and GPU should also decrease[/b] further.

Hopefully this will make your entire experience smoother and easier to control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/a97d733997c6d29918f7dbc14180c1331dbc8334.png[/img]

Regardless of fact that last two updates were strictly aimed at heavy optimizations, we've also corrected a few minor bugs and glitches, one of which was actually pretty noticeable but also somewhat funny - [b]snowman in front of your Town Hall won't be appearing in the middle of summer[/b] anymore :)

Final heads up on this occassion is that our work will proceed from this point, but we'll be again more concentrated at the game itself. We're aiming for [b]second part of July for another megaupdate[/b] and few more surprises...

Until then, 
Govern on!

notes.title: Update 1.400.0 – Player requested modifications and improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Patrons![/h1]

Update being released today is a [b]direct response to several leads provided by players[/b]. These leads indicates difficulties with people shifting homes or leaving the town, then needed improvements to some management panels, calculation and displaying of certain productions, more optimization etc…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/757313638947a53248e5fdef934dd7b9e2062a2c.jpg[/img]

When situation arises that your citizens have reasons to start leaving the town, they won't leave abruptly and in high numbers, so managing their needs should be easier. Previoulsy set up trade deals in harbors will now display a simple summary (on mouse hover), so it will be easier to keep track or your trade routes, especially if you have multiple harbors. FPS limiter has been added to options for those that requested it.

One more detail for all players that like planning and flawless execution in city organization - if you misplace the building, or change your mind where you want it - all invested resources will now be reimbursed in full if you remove the building before it is fully finished.

Based on your logs and other information provided by players, several more areas of gameplay have been identified that need to be modified. Some of these things are a little bit more extensive, and didn’t make it to this update, but are in the works already. To give you access to some improvements as soon as possible, we’ll be dividing the update in two parts. First part is today, and the second one will be in a few weeks.

Highlights of version 1.400.0. :

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]
[list]
[*] ADDED: Harbor summary: when you hover mouse over any harbor, you’ll see a summary data for current automated trade setups
[*] ADDED: FPS limiter option
[*] ADDED: If yet unfinished building is destroyed, 100% of invested resources is returned
[*] TWEAKED: Balance for people leaving town modified. They won’t leave too fast and too abruptly anymore  
[*] FIXED: When farm is selected, ESC key now works properly, in the following order: shutting down crop selection first, then icon for building additions, then game and initiating game menu
[*] MODIFIED: When citizens start demanding better housing (upgraded houses), correct notification will be displayed (not the incorrect homeless warning)
[*] MODIFIED: More precise display of production for some buildings. Buildings that require less then 50 resource units yearly for production, now show correct values
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/f5c01366ba8ceb40f998d198e1392afedccbf94f.jpg[/img]

We wish the administration of your medieval city will be a little bit easier now, and until next update!
Thanks for every and each piece of feedback, and for every data file you provide us. It all helps nailing down next steps with these updates!

Govern on!

notes.title: Taking out medieval heavy equipment – Update 1.330.4
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Patrons![/h3]

Today we have another update with some very nice content elements. Biggest single change can be traced to one suggestion that was continually being mentioned by many players for quite some time – introduction of [u][i][b]horses and carts[/b][/i][/u]. We absolutely agree that this definitely fits excellently into the game setting, plus will be beneficial from the gameplay perspective as well. So, here we are – finally ready with first “produced” horses for your benefit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/c57c52570afb7f7db13930a2f117050d4c31a503.png[/img]

Access to horses and carts is very simple – as soon as you build your first farms or other food producing parcels, [b]carts will appear in your depots[/b] and your people will start using them as help when gathering and transporting harvest. No more carrying everything on foot! 

Since last update we’ve also been working on several reported issues and improvements – regarding orchards, collected products, visual glitches and optimizations regarding models and shadow drawing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/64c8535875d3e47dee20930f2465e12391402f81.png[/img]

Lastly – there is another major change – with this update, Patron has been transferred to [b]Visual studio 2022[/b]. This is part of the preparation we had to do in order to open up a path forward for more updates and improvements down the road. This change shouldn’t affect the functionality of the game for vast majority of players, only exception might be for users of special Windows 7 version. They might have to switch to “Steam beta branch” of the game where we’ll do our best to provide further support.

Highlights of this update can be seen here:

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]
[list]
[*] ADDED: Horses and carts now exist to assist citizens carry harvest products around  
[*] UPGRADED: Harvest resources transport system changed – when harvest comes, not all citizens will now carry products, but only assigned worker will gather harvest, then it will be transported to warehouses via carts
[*] UPGRADED: New transport system for food harvests will reduce workforce requirements for carriers during harvest season, therefore freeing up more workers 
[*] FIXED: Reduced stutters with orchards during LOD transitions
[*] FIXED: Bags with harvested cotton are now normally visible when gathered and transported
[*] FIXED: Beetroot visual size increased and mage properly visible on fields
[*] OPTIMIZED: A number of 3D models have significantly optimized shadow drawing thus increasing performance
[*] MODIFIED: Entire game is now switched to Visual Studio 2022
[/list]

Before we end this announcement, another sneak peek for all of you – preparations have started for another sizeable update that will be added to Patron in mid July.

[i][b]Until then,
Govern on![/b][/i]

Before anything else, we'd like to apologize for the longer delay since the last update for Patron!

At this stage, the only way to find further increases in performance is to dig pretty deep, and we pursued it this time.

* Tree model optimizations
* Several building models optimizations
* Modifications to handling of in-game update loops
* Major upgrades to model drawing system
* Correction to few loading hints

All things considered, we've measured a noticeable increase in overall game performance following this update. According to your reports and log data, we'll continue to pursue further improvements in a manner similar to this update. 

[i][b]Until then, have fun![/b][/i]

Overseer Games

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
[i][b]Greetings Patrons![/b][/i]

As we enter Holiday season of 2021, all of us at Overseer Games sincerely hope that it will bring you more joy than the previous one. Last Year wasn’t without challenges for anyone, but we’re all still here, and we’re all looking forward, hoping and waiting for better things coming our way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/bd7a334c7ba823406dcbf62a4595b1954a7fb13d.png[/img]

Our digital [b]presents[/b] to you are here! In the recent weeks we’ve been working on the next fancy update for Patron. Some content elements were already announced, some were added along the way, but all things considered, it’s a nice collection of improvements, new content and some appropriate Christmas scenery – just what comes in handy for the long winter days!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/4b826db5ac6b9747464fa38a522967cd244de04f.jpg[/img]

Additionally, if you’re more into making your town shiny and nice, then there’s a nice [u][b]bundle of beautification[/b][/u] (more various statues, several different types of fences and hedges), as well as further improvements on how these beautifications are placed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/dbefed16dd7821fec68c4765925085ddc72c7555.jpg[/img]

As a mandatory thing in this Holiday time, we’ve also added a number of [u][b]visual surprises[/b][/u] to your town, just to enhance the cozy winter feeling. You’ll notice what we mean once your town enters winter time.

[*] Added combo bonus research that affects textile and book production

In the end, let us wish you all the best! [b]Merry Christmas and Happy New Year![/b]
Overseer Games

notes.content:
[i][b]Hello Patrons![/b][/i]

As we announced late last week, we're ready to push a bit more sizeable Update today.

There is something for everyone this time in terms of both new content, improvements of previous features and a bunch of fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/5d279e0b40b3ff6d82b0cd5bbe36be9e0ffca1fd.jpg[/img]

A quick breakdown of goodies from today's release…

[h1]First and foremost – the new stuff![/h1]
[list]
[*] New full map added: Caldera.
[*] New wild animal added to some maps: deer 
[*]The Clothes shop now has the ability to give citizens in its radius nice looking and fashionable hats and a small Happiness bonus to boot
[*] Added Scarecrow to crop field, if wheat or oats is planted
[*] Added loading screens hints
[*] Added new foliage on certain maps
[*] Added Quartz mining in Stone quarry (used in Glass production)
[*] Added University building for the educating of the young (12-20 yrs). Allows faster class advancement and elevated Education SI
[*] Added Book binder building – produces Books
[*] Added Paper Mill building – produces Paper
[*] Added Glassworks building – produces Glass
[/list]

[h1]Then a bunch of tweaks and improvements…[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the position of the Jewelry store I research to prevent researching Jewelry store II before the first one
[*] When switching trade deals from Docks to Harbor, game doesn't transfer maximum Dock trade amount anymore, but sets a new one as intended
[*] In buildings panel filter, the last building in the group isn't missing anymore
[*] If an adult lives in a Shelter, no marriage will occur
[*] When moving into a house, housing SI increases by +40, and when moving into a Shelter it increases by +20
[*] Continue button in the main menu now properly detects the last used save
[*] Combo bonuses are now set properly if you simultaneously build two buildings that affect each other
[*] Farmers in Fields and Orchards now literally pick up harvest from plant to plant, during harvest season
[*] Tweaked Pest event: radius between affected fields is increased, and probability of infection for adjacent field is decreased
[*] Tweaked Research:  the balance between several research prices and research durations has been adjusted
[*] Tweaked Cookies prices and rebalanced the Bakery
[*] The size of Tornado disaster is increased
[*] Tweaked difficulty: on higher difficulty settings, adult population consumes more food in later years
[*] Tweaked difficulty: on higher difficulty settings, adult population consumes more luxuries in later years
[*] Tweaked climate variables: dry and tropical climate now require more firewood in temperatures of 15 degrees Celsius and below
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/795a74cbd7e0777f3187388a265551bbb06405ff.png[/img]

[h1]And finally, a batch of additional fixes…[/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrected the Townhose typo
[*] Leaves on trees now have a proper coloring change when switching from Winter to Spring
[*] Corrected situation when wrong SI hint was shown on one of the answers on the King's ransom event
[*] Corrected a bug that could cause workers to not pick up crops from the fields
[*] Corrected a possible bug when game reloading sometimes kept field crops resources/lumber in a forest to linger from the previous save
[*] Orchard III research now unlocks seeds it should
[*] Buildings panel icons are now properly aligned and do not overlap with other visuals
[*] When building a road, all plants in its path are now properly removed
[/list]

We hope you'll like this update. Many elements will be obvious from the start, others will pop out as you play the game further, and for some nice details you'll have to really pay attention. But overall, we're confident this update pushes the game another step towards an even more enjoyable experience for all of you!

And as usual – this isn't the end, more updates are on the way…

Enjoy and govern on!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1760000/Patron__Mare_Nostrum/

But that's not all! We've prepared a nice update for the base game as well! There's actually more things we've done, but they're required more testing so we'll be releasing a few more smaller updates over the next couple of days. Without further ado, here's the changelog:

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]A brand new production building, the [b]Charcoal burner[/b], as requested numerous times, has finally landed. It's early in the research chain so you can reap the benefits early on.

[*]Changed the calculation on how much cash is requested in the [i]The Church needs money[/i] event
[*]All dropdown lists now have a classic (standard) scrollbar to make it more visible.
[*]Trade deal list is expanded to show 6 resources.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/0b1648ea1e74977151ce0f50c8b2915d61b38b7f.png[/img]

Greetings Patrons!

How about another update, huh? :)

Highlight of this build is the highly requested [b]Auto-trade[/b] and two new buildings!

[h2]Auto-trade panel - Trade deals[/h2]
The harbor now has a fully functional automatic trade mechanic. You can set up to 4 deals on each harbor, to buy, sell or both for a specific resource. The harbor also received a new upgrade to increase the size of each individual [i]automatic trade[/i].

[h2]Brick mansion[/h2]
Two story houses are no longer the [i]peak of housing luxury[/i]. Introducing the Brick mansion: top-of-the-line, high-class, loved-by-the-gentry, made-out-of-brick, mansion. Upgrade from two story house is possible. Don't forget to research it first ;).

[h2]Large warehouse[/h2]

Greetings everyone!

As the title says, it's update time!

We'll go over the highlights first, and as always, you can find the changelog below.

[h2]Family dynamics change[/h2]
This is just the first step in a bigger overhaul aimed at preventing the [i]population snowball[/i] that a lot of you experienced.
[list]
[*]Citizens leave their parental home later, though there are additional modifier that change this.
[*]Implemented a progressive chance reduction for couples to get more children, if they already have children.

[h2]Relevant info feed during events[/h2]
One of the things gravely missing when an event happens is a way to see the current status of important resources and social issues. This is no more. Hover the mouse over  an event answer, and you'll get a nice, filtered recap of the relevant stats.

[h2]Quality of life upgrades[/h2]
Several tidbits that were requested on the forum and on discord like some added info on tooltips or additional important indicators.

[*]Added event hints to provide more info on the current status of important resources and social issues.

[*]Automatic trade on docks/harbor - As requested. Also, not much to add to this.
[*]Performance optimization - It's time to tackle this as well
[/list]

Naturally there will be more done, fixed and implemented, buthis is just a taste of things to come.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/c1372c9eaf9c5c448e96400b3fb810ea3927bd15.jpg[/img]

Evening (if it's evening to you fine players),

Day 3, update 3. We're going through the reported issues as fast as we can, but we're also doing our best to test everything out as best as we can.

Yesterday's update introduced the resource locks and got a big chunk of the resource stock caps in place, but as you probably know, not everything was working as intended. We spent most of today looking in that direction, though a few other things were done as well.

[h2]Let's talk about resource caps a bit more[/h2]
If you take a look at the image above, we're calling it smart caps. In essence, we're trying to make these caps do some automatization. If for example you limit a resource on 500, the building producing that resource eyeballs the limit and if the limit is close by, pulls the brakes, but not entirely if there is still room in the stock before the limit is hit. If the building throttles down by 75%, the upkeep is also reduced. Nothing groundbreaking, but it should assist nicely.

[h3]Are there any exceptions to the caps?[/h3]
Yes, and you'll likely notice them. Namely resources that come into the stock in large quantities in a short period of time. That goes mostly for fields, orchards etc. The limit [i]is[/i] there, but if a large number of your workers/carriers already grab field produce to get to the stock, before the limit is triggered, they will get the resource into the stock. We were debating whether to enforce a hard limit, but that would mean you could lose quite a bit of resources and that didn't seem right. But hey, do let us know what you think :).

On a side-note, we've buffed the Gatherer's shelter and Fisherman's hut. Nothing major, but to help out a bit. Check the changelog for details.

Oh, and another side-note regarding the later-stage [i]snowballing[/i] of villagers. That is being addressed, but it impacts a number of different game systems, so we're being extra careful with it.

That covers the most important bit. Change-log time.

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resource stock smart caps (quite a bit was changed, re-done or added since Update 2, so I'll count it as [i]addition[/i]
[*]And something specific for Forester's hut: if lumber is capped in the stock, and the limit reached, the forester will automatically switch to just planting (in the background. he will resume his work when supply drops below limit)
[*]Added a couple of checks and safeties to make sure the Gatherer's shelter doesn't suddenly stop producing (this and/or similar was reported)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a potential crash that could happen when lifting fullscreen in non-native screen resolution
[*]Fixed a potential crash that could happen while interacting with the ranch and adding new animals
[*]Fixed a number of issues related to Steam achievements that would cause them to display unused stat counters
[*]Added a number of additional checks for some achievements to make sure they fire off
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gatherer's shelter production got a boost
[*]Fisherman's hut production got a boost (both production lines)
[*]Fisherman's hut (fish production) no longer requires lumber
[*]Fisherman's hut (crab production) no longer requires iron
[*]Forester's hut production got a boost
[/list]

That's it for Update 3. We'll see you again soon!
Overseer

notes.title: Post release Update 2
notes.content:
[i][b]Evening everyone or morning or good day, depending on where you are at the moment[/b][/i]

Another long night and day is behind us, but we're ready to share the [i]post-release Update 2[/i]. The general rule was the same as with the previous patch : improving gameplay by tweaking existing things and adding useful details that were requested by the players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/eaa458910b6772c803bbec8863c3371cf702f095.jpg[/img]

We've also fixed a number of reported glitches and finished several things that were announced for yesterday's patch, but testing took longer than anticipated.

The list of changes is below, but in short, you should have an easier time managing things in the game, have more feedback from the game and have more resilient people that won't die as soon as their bellies aren't stuffed ːsteamhappyː

Now it's full steam ahead towards Update 3! But first a bit of info...

[h2]How do the resource locks work?[/h2]
When you [i]lock[/i] a resource, it is no longer allowed for citizens to take this resource from the stock to consume it BUT(!) there are exceptions:
[list]
[*]if there is no [i]unlocked[/i] alternative, they will take what they can, even if locked
[*]if there is only ONE food allowed, they will grab at least one other, even if locked, because if they don't you'll have a lot of health bars dropping (not enough food diversity leads to sickness). the unlocked food will still be the majority of their food intake
[*]if all the luxuries are locked, they'll get in there and grab something
[/list]
To lock a resource, find it in the Stock panel, and toggle the lock button, right next to the cap limiter.

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Immigration now brings people from all social classes, not just peasants
[*]When people get married, if they are not of the same social class, the spouse of the lower social class will move up in class
[*]You can now [i]lock[/i] a resource in the stockpile panel to prevent it from being used by the citizens for consumption. This effectively means the resource can only be used in production.
[*]Added a couple of new notifications regarding deaths and emigration
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Limiting the maximum amount of a resource in the stockpile now works as intended.
[*]Done a number of fixes and changes to make sure Achievements are fired off correctly
[*]Fixed a glitch related to the refresh of the max cap input on the Stockpile panel
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Carriers and workers will now haul enough upkeep resources to fulfill the demand for longer. This optimizes times usage and reduces the chance for problems in production.
[*]Changed how fire behaves in terms of duration.
[*]School ambient SFX changed to a one less irritating
[*]On the [i]Normal[/i] start preset, disasters are now set to [i]normal[/i] as intended, not [i]low[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Is that all?[/h2]
Nah. Steam trading cards passed certification, so now you'll start getting some of those ;).

Enjoy and have fun!
Overseer Games

After an avalanche of awesome and constructive feedback during Steam Playtest, we've adjusted our plans for the final development steps regarding the full version of Patron. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/9a7e574185fb6c9dc3401d49c047a4136e392431.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Languages for demo and loads of other improvements
notes.content:
[i][b]Good day everyone![/b][/i]

Before we start closing down the game version for the upcoming Steam Playtest this weekend, it's a good time to make a nice [b]update of the public demo[/b] version as well! 

One of the highlights of this update is unlocking of nearly all planned [b]languages[/b] for Patron. So far, players of the demo came from all over the world and we're trying to bring the game closer to everyone, as much as possible. There might still be glitches and missing words, but that will be further improved until release version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/f749629090a652e9148ac18534d49102aca4a4a1.jpg[/img]

We couldn't add everything that we worked on since the demo is limited, but there are still some great additions:

[list]
[*] Added a number of different languages (except Japanese for now). Still needs some polish but they can be selected and used from game launcher 
[*] Added character animations for people working in production buildings
[*] Added influence of social issues to behavior of characters
[*] Added a number of notifications, linked to upcoming problems because of some emerging social issue
[*] Added riots (in front of Town Hall) when certain social issue drops below acceptable level
[*] Added several new buildings for production and beautifications (different town banners, Oil mill, Shrine, Cemetery, Mushroom farm, Fishery…)
[*] Added several items for production and trading (sunflower, oil, medicine, lamps...)
[*] Added another balancing pass for production and consumption
[*] Fixed influence and benefits of several buildings (like wells)
[*] Animals on ranches are now consuming oats for food
[*] Added shortcut mapping in the in-game options
[*] Added new data graphs on the Stock panel with overviews for [b]coins[/b] and [b]food[/b]
[*] Fixed numerous glitches linked to the Jobs board panel
[*] Fixed numerous bugs that were detected or reported by players 
[/list]

Please note that from this updated version, [u][b]old save files will unfortunately not work anymore[/b][/u]. Some of the changes were profound and a de-sync of the version couldn’t be avoided this time. Since it had to be done, we’ve decided it is better sooner rather than later, and it is better to do this on the demo version than later on the full version. Sincere apologies for this, but we had to make a more significant step with the version this time. 

As before, we welcome your continuous feedback. If you encounter any issues, please let us know in the bugs&technical subthread on Steam community forum, and if you’re sending us log and save files, please make sure they come from the latest demo version. It really helps us nail problems faster!

And, in the end – if you have an interest and haven’t already, [b]apply to participate in our Playtest[/b] this weekend. All those selected (randomly by Steam) will receive access to the unlocked game version for two days, and we’d love to know your thoughts!

Enjoy!
Overseer Games

notes.title: A nice pack of updates for the Patron demo
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello,[/b][/i]

As promised before the demo version of Patron was released, we are going to [b]update the demo[/b] as well. Lots of players have been playing the demo, and offered a lot of feedback. Thus, we've decided it is time to make a comprehensive update to the demo and do what we can that everyone playing it has an even better experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305257/41c34af906bf3e34afb54d6af20f87632c59afa8.jpg[/img]

The demo is still limited, and still doesn't represent the completed game, but the intention is to iron out some issues and include some additions for an even better "first look". 

Anyways, here are the most important elements of this update:

[list]
[*] Bridges can be built only over rivers and must start/end at dry land
[*] Placed bridges will not crash the save files anymore
[*] Stone road now has a price in stone
[*] Annual panel added - log with better overview of what is happening in game
[*] Added new building - Watchtower that increases security in its radius, available from the start
[*] When Forester plants a tree, it grows twice as fast as ordinary forest tree 
[*] Improved behavior of wild animals - they don't move through houses or across rivers
[*] Trade panel data is now refreshed in real time
[*] Increasing or decreasing amount of resources in trade panel (on "+" or "-") now increases in speed if you keep it pressed longer
[*] Clicking the temperature info in Status panel now switches between Celsius and Fahrenheit scales
[*] Improvements of citizens' pathfinding
[*] Text font has been replaced for technical reasons
[*] Visual changes to unoccupied houses or inactive production buildings - no smoke from chimneys, no visual traces of activity until reactivated
[*] Combo bonuses in buildings are now working as intended
[*] Fixed a number of tooltips
[*] Residents hint, on status panel now also displays the number of houses, both available and populated ones
[*] Additional optimizations when loading various structures and objects in the game world in general
[*] Better balance between Easy/Normal/Hard difficulties
[*] Additional balancing tweaks
[*] Numerous fixes of text glitches and small bugs 
[/list]

Hope you'll like the improvements, and it will keep you busy while we continue working on the full game build!

Enjoy,
Overseer Games
